compaction_lines: - **Backtest arms:** PRIOR, WO5_SHRINK, M3_RATES, BLEND_RATES, CAREER_RATES, M3_RATES_M3_MIN.
- **User feedback (latest):** the user rejects the 20-year backtest as irrelevant: careers are mostly under 8 years, and the game, rules and pace have changed.
- **The user now disputes the backtest's era span.** The analysis must be redone on recent seasons only.

- **Address the integrity concern.** Acknowledge it plainly. Re-run both backtests (history blend and usage budget) restricted to the modern era, e.g. target seasons from roughly 2019-20 through 2025-26, with per-36 rates and season-relative usage capacity. Fit and judge within that window, e.g. fit on the earlier recent seasons, test on the latest 2–3, or leave-one-season-out. Also stratify by career length ≤ 8 seasons. Report whether the conclusions hold, change, or lose significance (sample sizes stated).

- **Present the WO-5b candidate** (history blend + new-team usage) with dry-run board effects (kit engine, in memory), and ask the owner for a go/no-go decision. Draft is Wednesday 10/14; do not apply without owner approval. "A question gets an assessment, not a fix."

- Immediately before the interrupt, I had built the dry-run candidate (candidate_wo5b.py). It printed team usage factors (POR .923, PHI .951 … BOS 1.095), 104/622 unmatched roster names, and 326 changed lines.
- The next intended step was computing candidate boards and comparisons.

- The user then interrupted to object to the 20-year span of the backtests: "I do not agree with the 20 year test. Majority of players in the NBA (fantasy relevance) have under an 8 year playing career. Data that goes back 20 years is irrelevant and I do not see the significance as the game, rules, pacing have all changed in that span."

- Re-run backtest_history.py and backtest_usage.py restricted to recent seasons (e.g. targets 2019-20..2025-26), with the in-sample/out-of-sample split also inside that window. Add a ≤8-season-career stratum. Report results with sample sizes, from records, before any recommendation.
- Then complete the dissertation response and the WO-5b candidate comparison, ending with an owner decision on whether to apply it before the 10/14 draft.
